7272.title: Native terminal resource ownership needs Windows verification
7272.rootCauseOneLine: Candidate in pinned node-pty native source: shell exit erases the resource record before a later kill can close the pseudoconsole. Windows execution remains unverified; BB already disposes the PTY.
7272.proposedFix: First run the supplied native process-count test on isolated Windows. If the record-loss candidate is confirmed, repair exact-once native pseudoconsole ownership and cleanup, including shell-exit and active-kill races.
7272.caveats: Both clean attempts ran on Linux, with real BB terminal completion passing and the Windows native-process audit unavailable. verified means the second clean run supports this limited report, not that Windows leakage was reproduced. No safe simple fix without Windows failure evidence; the candidate is in a native dependency.
